CustomField.description: Per-section override of Contact duplicate-match resolution, read by Form_Submission_Convert_Setup (getPageSection branch, falling back to the Form Template's value). When the Contact Matching Rules return more than one match, true updates the most confident match instead of creating a new Contact during conversion.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the Contact matching rules find several possible matches during conversion, turn this on to update the most confident match rather than create a new Contact. This setting applies to just this section and otherwise inherits the Form Template's setting.
CustomField.label: Update Most Confident (Contact)
